lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for most kinds of changes because almost all categories have only 1 test so far.
home, new_flow changes did not work, showing a consistent negative impact across 2 tests (-2.5% average after noise correction).
finish, new_screen and choose_path, hint changes worked and won their tests, though evidence for these categories remains thin with only 1 test each.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests compared to noise-corrected results.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Sign-In Deferred Flow
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding flow so account sign-in happens after pet selection and adoption certificate generation.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate at 60.9%. Allowing users to choose and adopt their pet before signing in builds commitment and improves sign-in motivation.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in to occur after adoption certificate is permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Flow reorders carry high risk based on negative home new_flow tests (-2.5%).

candidates.title: Stage Layout for Path Selection
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen into a stage layout with interactive visual path cards.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a very high mean duration (514s), indicating users struggle to evaluate options on the current layout.

guard.reason: Redesigning choose_path with a stage layout and choice cards retains the path selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high mean duration (514s) on choose_path, but redesign requires new screens.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated interactive desktop controls checklist screen right after home intro.
candidates.why: Support mail highlighted multiple tickets where users were confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup, and finish + new_screen changes previously succeeded.

new_controls_guide.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
new_controls_guide.body: Quick tips on how to summon, drag, talk to, and hide your pet on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Adding a new controls walkthrough screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail backing and finish new_screen changes previously won (+8.9%).

candidates.title: Two-Column Pet Customization Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a two-column layout featuring a live preview of the pet alongside options.
candidates.why: Adoption is the biggest drop-off point (60.9% conversion) and support reported emails about custom pets looking wrong or failing.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend layout with a live preview maintains pet selection capability.

candidates.score_note: Targets biggest funnel drop-off (60.9%) with support mail evidence; layout changes had modest positive results (+1.4%).

candidates.title: Choose Path Quick Selection Hint
candidates.change: Display a hint on the choose path screen letting users know they can change their companion style later in settings.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean 514s to complete, suggesting decision anxiety, and previous lessons show choose_path hint tests won.

choose_path.hint: You can change your companion style anytime later in app settings.

guard.reason: Adding an informational hint to choose_path screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint update; choose_path hint tests previously won (+2.7%).

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Readiness Progress Display
candidates.change: Show an explicit progress bar and estimated time remaining during the desktop pet launch waiting screen.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s, while support reported issues with pets not displaying or app stalling.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Setting up desktop overlay and background pet engine...

guard.reason: Adding a progress indicator and estimated wait time to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support and mean time (2336s), but home step changes have historically underperformed.

candidates.title: Background Setup Desktop Notification Alert
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification alerts when the desktop pet generation finishes in the background.
candidates.why: High mean completion time (2336s) indicates users switch away during waiting; notification alerts bring them back when ready.

waiting.hint: We will notify you when your pet is ready on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding background completion notification hints for the waiting screen is allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Notification changes performed poorly (-1.8%) and home changes showed negative impact.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Official Seal Badge
candidates.change: Add an official companion badge component to the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet setup.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%); adding a rewarding official badge increases completion motivation.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.official_stamp' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'badge', 'image'] with an asset:stamp/ asset

candidates.title: Account Sync and Pet Recovery Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in saves their pet and prevents reset.
candidates.why: Support mail received 8 tickets regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sync & Preserve Your Desktop Pet
sign_in.body: Sign in to save your pet companion, customize items, and protect your progress across app restarts.

guard.reason: Updating sign_in copy to explain pet synchronization is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Direct support mail evidence (8 tickets) and low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Shortcut Controls Tip
candidates.change: Update home_intro text and hint to explain hotkeys for summoning and hiding the pet on desktop.
candidates.why: Support receives user complaints about not knowing how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Use quick controls to interact with your pet anytime on screen.
home_intro.hint: Right-click your pet to open actions, or drag it anywhere on screen!

guard.reason: Updating home_intro text and hints with desktop control tips is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy/hint update targeting user confusion reported in support.

picked: Account Sync and Pet Recovery Copy

decisions.title: Account Sync and Pet Recovery Copy

shipped: Account Sync and Pet Recovery Copy
lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for most kinds of changes because almost all categories have only 1 test so far.
home, new_flow changes did not work, consistently showing negative impacts across 2 tests (-2.6% average after noise correction).
finish, new_screen and choose_path, hint each won 1 test, but a second test of each showed no clear effect, so evidence remains mixed.
Predictions were generally too high overall compared to actual noise-corrected results.
